lines.line: 161 dead in eight days. Where is the outrage?
A party wins an election. Then its gunmen hunt down the rival party.
They throw a rival from a fifteen story building, hands and legs tied.
They shoot captured men, again and again, in the legs.
They execute a rival leader in the street.
Within days, they control the whole territory.
How could they? Where are the protests? Where is the U.N.?
That was <<h|ɑ|ˈ|m|ɑ|s>>, killing Fatah. Gaza, June 2007.
A Palestinian rights group counted 161 dead. 41 were civilians.
Strange. You don't remember the protests?
Fatah forces committed abuses too. They threw a <<h|ɑ|ˈ|m|ɑ|s>> preacher from a high rise.
If you love Israeli facts, follow Noam Roz for more.
Now watch it again, knowing who.
